note: Both sets misread the Living Room finished floor as 2' - 3 1/2" when the sheet shows 2' - 9 1/2" in both sections. Set A otherwise binds values correctly and adds supported facts B misses (sheet title BUILDING SECTIONS, lot number 116, West Module adjacent to Centre Module, Mechanical Room within Centre Module). Set B adds several vague or trivial claims (WEST MODULE located 'West', 'building section contains room ...', Mechanical Room located in 'Building Section A302') and misbinds CENTRE MODULE to grid line K, which the section does not support. Set A is more faithful overall despite one shared error and a couple of duplicate claims.
